title: CHG-3659: change record for the Expense Desk
body:
SUMMARY:

This memo records a change to the Expense Desk that is currently pending. The
work affects 8 production hosts behind the Expense Desk and was raised by Grace
Okafor from Infrastructure.

DETAILS:

The implementation plan, prepared with Meridian Cloud, covers these steps during
the 22:00-23:30 UTC window:
- Move the nightly export to the new object store bucket
- Add a read replica in the secondary region for reporting
- Upgrade the message broker to the current long-term release

DECISION:

As recorded by the board, this change is an open request. Omar Haddad filed this
record on 5 September 2025 after the board session of 18 May 2025; minutes are
in the shared archive.
